howto.name: Upload a video
howto.text: Select an MP4, WebM, MOV, or AVI file up to 500 MB.

howto.name: Set GIF parameters
howto.text: Choose the start time, duration (max 30 seconds recommended for file size), frame rate (10–30 fps), and output width.

howto.name: Convert and download
howto.text: Click Convert. FFmpeg extracts the frames and optimizes the color palette for the smallest possible GIF.

faq.q: What is the maximum GIF duration?
faq.a: There is no strict limit, but GIFs longer than 15-30 seconds can become very large. Keeping clips short produces better results.

faq.q: Can I control the file size?
faq.a: Yes. Lower the frame rate (10 fps is usually enough), reduce the width, and shorten the duration to get smaller files.
MP4, WebM, MOV, and AVI. The server uses FFmpeg, which supports virtually all common video codecs.
